If something is fine, it is OK, not a problem, or acceptable.
defs.example: She said it works -- it's fine.

defs.text: If something is fine, it is very good in quality.
defs.example: This is a fine example of how we can work together.

defs.text: If the weather is fine, the sun is out and it is not raining or snowing.
If something works fine, it works well, or without any problems.
defs.example: Going there today would suit me fine.

defs.text: If you draw or cut something fine, you do it in very small pieces or with small detail.
A fine is money that you pay for breaking a rule or the law.
defs.example: There is a $500 fine for smoking inside.

defs.text: If you fine someone, you make them pay money for breaking a rule or the law.
defs.example: He was fined $500 for smoking inside.

defs.text: To make something finer in quality or size.
defs.example: The wine will fine with time.

defs.text: the products of human creativity; works of art collectively
